about: The model catalogue: models as their published configurations give them (Hugging Face config.json, text model only). modelFromConfig() (src/parts/01c-catalogue.ts) turns one into a model preset: total and read-per-token weights are computed from the dimensions, and checked against the published parameter count (publishedParams, of the text model: visionParams, the vision encoder and projector a multimodal checkpoint also carries, is left out, as a GGUF keeps it in a separate mmproj file). Baked into the page (tools/baked.mjs) as presets next to the app's own four (src/parts/01-data.ts, MODELS), shown in the Loadout and What fits; tools/fit-families.mjs and tools/accuracy.mjs use the ones the published benchmarks ran. 'llama8b' is the app's own Llama 3.1 8B preset. vendor and family group the Loadout's filter; tag is the Ollama name. expertBpw: the routed experts are stored at this width in every file, whatever the label (gpt-oss: MXFP4). Gated repositories (Meta, Google) do not serve config.json without a sign-in: their dimensions come from an ungated copy (configCopy) and are checked against the parameter count the official repository publishes, which they reproduce exactly. notes: what the model's own schema cannot express, or worth knowing; approx: the notes describe an approximation the estimate makes (sliding-window layers treated as full attention), which the card marks.

llama3.2-3b.name: Llama 3.2 3B
llama3.2-3b.notes: Tied embeddings: the output head is the embedding table.

qwen2.5-32b.name: Qwen2.5 32B
qwen2.5-32b.notes: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B has the same dimensions (https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B/blob/main/config.json), with 131,072 positions; Qwen2.5 32B Instruct states 32,768 (131,072 with YaRN).

gemma3-4b.name: Gemma 3 4B
gemma3-4b.notes: Five of every six layers attend over a 1,024-token sliding window; the model treats every layer as full attention, so it over-counts the KV cache at long context (llama.cpp keeps only the window for those layers). The SigLIP vision encoder (0.42B) is left out.

mistral-small3.2-24b.name: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
mistral-small3.2-24b.notes: The text model (text_config); Mistral Small 3.1 (2503) has the same one. The Pixtral vision encoder and projector (0.44B) are left out. No sliding window.

gpt-oss-20b.name: gpt-oss-20b
gpt-oss-20b.notes: Experts are MXFP4 (4.25 bits) in every file, whatever its label; the label sets attention, router and embeddings. Every other layer attends over a 128-token sliding window, with learned attention sinks: the model treats every layer as full attention, so it over-counts the KV cache at long context.

gpt-oss-120b.name: gpt-oss-120b
gpt-oss-120b.notes: As gpt-oss-20b: MXFP4 experts in every file, the label sets the rest; every other layer a 128-token sliding window, treated as full attention.
